thread:
jonathan: saw a customer ticket where provisional billing spiked during lots of short reconnects. console shows provisional tokens >> confirmed and customers are worried.
anika: Which rollout/timestamp? any matching deploy events?
jonathan: Happened around 2025-01-15 15:04:xx UTC. ops-bot deployed router v2 earlier that hour.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: router v2 rollforward started 2025-01-15T14:58:02Z, completed 2025-01-15T15:02:10Z
dave: quick log excerpt: ```
[2025-01-15T15:03:45Z] session=zx9 prefix_hash=0x7f attempt=1 event=stream_start
[2025-01-15T15:03:48Z] session=zx9 attempt=1 event=tool_call tokens=80
[2025-01-15T15:03:50Z] client reconnect, new attempt=2
[2025-01-15T15:03:51Z] session=zx9 attempt=2 event=tool_call tokens=80 provisional=true
[2025-01-15T15:04:05Z] final_ack attempt=2 confirmed=true
```
jonathan: billing ledger shows two provisional entries briefly and only one confirmed. Our dedupe key is attempt id, so reconnects create new ledger rows.
anika: Is session always present? here it is, but lots of SDKs don't set it. we can't rely solely on session.
dave: thought: dedupe key = (session || client_ip+start_ts_floor) + prefix_hash; if prefix_hash matches and reconnect within Xs, mark second as replay and tag provisional. Ledger should keep provisional rows but not finalize until confirmation.
billing-bot: billing-bot: New field request: support ledger entry tag "provisional_reason" (values: replay, client_retry, router_retry) and expose in billing export.
claire: UX: customers interpret "provisional" as charged. Console should show provisional timeline and a hover explanation: "provisional = may be reconciled when duplicate attempts confirmed". Also add filter to show only confirmed cost.
jonathan: Also add alerting: if provisional_sum - confirmed_sum > threshold for an organization, send ops alert. we had a case hit 2k tokens diff.
anika: Telemetry: emit reconnect_origin (client|router|network), replayed_prefix_len, original_attempt_ts, and a dedupe_hint boolean. This will help tune X.
dave: short-term mitigation: router can reuse attempt id when it sees same prefix in cache and reconnect within 8s. long-term: persist attempt mapping in a small MV store to survive router restarts.
claire: For console reconcile UX: add an "auto-reconcile provisional after N minutes" toggle (default off) and an action to "force-explain" that shows traces for the provisional rows.
billing-bot: filed BILL-1029 to add ledger tags and export fields.
jonathan: ok i'll open a tiny RFC for the dedupe key change + telemetry schema. please comment if you see billing risk (under/over).
anika: watch out: some legitimate retries should be billed (e.g., client retried after server crash with no duplicate). our heuristic must prefer safety: prefer provisional marking but require final ack to confirm.
dave: i'll prototype router-side attempt reuse and a telemetry flag in next PR. pairing with @jonathan.
claire: adding console mock to PR too. thanks all. :sparkles:
